title: TopologyRelationshipQualifierRequirement
description: One qualifier that may be needed to compile a relationship intent, for example VLAN id, VRF, routing protocol, site id, or cloud account.

name.description: Stable qualifier name used in TopologyRelationshipIntent.qualifiers.

catalogId.description: Optional semantic catalog field id that defines this qualifier's meaning.

displayName.description: Short display name for prompt context and diagnostics.

description.description: Brief explanation of when this qualifier is required.

required.description: Whether this qualifier must be present for compile.

allowedValues.description: Legacy/simple bounded candidate values when topology-service can safely advertise them. Prefer options for relationship-facing clarification because it includes labels, status, truncation, and diagnostics.

options.description: Optional scoped option discovery result for this qualifier. Absence means the caller may ask free-form and topology-service validates at compile time.
